name: SharePoint content types
short_description: Reusable SharePoint definitions that bundle site columns and settings for a category of documents or items, such as a policy or contract, so metadata stays consistent across libraries and sites.

evidence.quote: Second content types. A content type bundles a set of columns into a definition of what kind of document this is.
Content types extend this model by bundling together a set of columns, templates, and workflows
The columns belonged to the same content type.
